observation: The selected p5.brush mechanism is material production, not a visual style. v044 translates it into carrier formation and refuses brush surface vocabulary.
consequence: Keep the source relation in the causal rule and do not add texture to make the citation legible.

observation: A pending load is exact; only an ordered three-well release can change the carrier and tokens.
consequence: The image must show a single body being re-formed, not three decorated controls.

observation: The engine replays history from a quiet seed and exposes load order, carrier signature, token signatures, lifting, and release as deterministic operations.
consequence: A later cast inherits earlier carrier changes instead of mutating a snapshot in place.

observation: The canvas is the first encounter; the load rail is kept low and secondary, while the title and prose follow the tableau.
consequence: Do not let controls or annotation become the work's main composition.

observation: The rupture is materially different from the last three records, but a blind render may still be mistaken for a typographic poster if the carrier deformation is too subtle.
consequence: Hold until caption-free screenshots show the carrier's structural re-formation at phone and desktop sizes.

observation: The pointer path, touch path, keyboard path, and deterministic center control all lead to the same cast grammar; incomplete and repeated loads are refused.
consequence: Probe one real gesture and one keyboard path; do not describe a slider as agency.

observation: The canvas reserves its own field and keeps the lower rail inside the same coordinate system, with 44px controls and a mobile-specific scale.
consequence: Verify scroll width, canvas bounds, control reachability, and blind preview at 320px and 390px.

observation: The record can honestly claim a candidate artifact, tests, and deployed readbacks only after those are observed; no perceptual approval is inferred from metadata.
consequence: Keep candidate / held and list the missing evidence rather than promoting the work.

observation: The local record, canonical page, raw tableau, public catalog, Journal anchor, favicon, and stable production route must be read back separately.

observation: If the blind work reads as a styled word poster, or if load order only changes a label, the translation has failed even if the engine tests pass.
consequence: Delete this direction rather than polish its texture; the next trial must change medium or encounter again.
